results.snippet: July 2, 2026 - LangChain's document loaders and retrievers are strong for the standard cases, and LangChain even promotes first-class LlamaIndex retriever integrations because that depth can be valuable. We did this by making persistence a first class citizen in LangGraph. Every step of the graph, it reads from and then writes to a checkpoint of that graph state. That checkpoint makes interrupt-and-resume work: pause an AI agent for a human approval, then resume from exactly where it stopped.

results.snippet: July 2, 2026 - LangChain's document loaders and retrievers are strong for the standard cases, and LangChain even promotes first-class LlamaIndex retriever integrations because that depth can be valuable. Most agents need persistence. They need it the moment a workflow has to wait on a human, hold context across hours, or recover from a crashed run. ... We did this by making persistence a first class citizen in LangGraph. Every step of the graph, it reads from and then writes to a checkpoint of that graph state. That checkpoint makes interrupt-and-resume work: pause an AI agent for a human approval, then resume from exactly where it stopped.

results.snippet: July 2, 2026 - LangChain's document loaders and retrievers are strong for the standard cases, and LangChain even promotes first-class LlamaIndex retriever integrations because that depth can be valuable. Most agents need persistence. They need it the moment a workflow has to wait on a human, hold context across hours, or recover from a crashed run. ... We did this by making persistence a first class citizen in LangGraph. Every step of the graph, it reads from and then writes to a checkpoint of that graph state. That checkpoint makes interrupt-and-resume work: pause an AI agent for a human approval, then resume from exactly where it stopped.
